column3: NASB follows the critical text with “righteousness” (Textus Receptus: “alms”); “to be seen” is rendered “to be noticed.”
NASB renders “do acts of charity” as “give to the poor,” “have glory” as “be honored,” and adds “in full” to “they have their reward.”
Close to the Greek; “doing charity” is rendered “give to the poor.”
